# FLX-3106: run artifact would be written inside the bundle

**Family:** seam/conformance (the 3000 band)

A bundle is the input a run is answerable to. Writing a run artifact into it would mean the next replay reads a directory the previous run changed, and the inputDigest of KERNEL-SPEC §11 would no longer name the bytes the run was given. Choose a destination outside the bundle directory.

## Look it up offline

```console
$ fluxsim explain FLX-3106
```

Every code is listed in the [error index](./README.md).
